{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-bdgk","title":"TH_3 and TH_4 use plaintext instead of ciphertext per RFC 9528","description":"RFC 9528 §4.1.2 defines TH_3 = H(TH_2, CIPHERTEXT_2) and TH_4 = H(TH_3, CIPHERTEXT_3). The ponytail EDHOC implementation in rust/lichen-oscore/src/edhoc.rs computes both TH_3 and TH_4 over decrypted plaintext (plaintext_2, plaintext_3) instead of the ciphertext as received over the wire. This affects:

- Initiator TH_3 (line 858): transcript_3(..., &pending.plaintext, ...) — uses decrypted plaintext_2
- Responder TH_3 (line 1242): transcript_3(..., &plaintext_2, ...) — uses plaintext before encryption  
- Initiator TH_4 (line 909): transcript_4(..., &ciphertext_3.0, ...) — actually uses ciphertext here (correct for initiator)
- Responder TH_4 (line 1403): transcript_4(..., &pending.plaintext, ...) — uses decrypted plaintext_3 (INCORRECT)
- Test vectors (line 2109, 2128): both use plaintext_2 and plaintext_3

The initiator and responder are currently internally consistent (they both use plaintext for TH_3, both use plaintext for TH_4 on the responder side but ciphertext on the initiator side...), but they will not interoperate with any RFC 9528-compliant EDHOC implementation. The test vectors at lines 2101-2112 and 2120-2129 should also be updated to use ciphertext.","status":"open","priority":0,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"agent@lichen-project.dev","created_at":"2026-07-24T17:16:19.090233544Z","created_by":"AI Agent","updated_at":"2026-07-24T17:16:19.090233544Z","dependencies":[{"issue_id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-bdgk","depends_on_id":"commit:2877239","type":"discovered-from","created_at":"2026-07-24T17:16:19.237942747Z","created_by":"AI Agent","metadata":"{}"}]}
